name: @gamerelay/sdk
description: Multiplayer for browser games without a server: rooms, entity sync with smoothing, host migration, chat and leaderboards. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/gamerelay.mjs --format esm --minify --target browser && bun build src/global.ts --outfile dist/gamerelay.js --format iife --minify --target browser
